title: EGTRAIN live frame version 1
description: One frame of the live contract: a JSON object that describes a run (hello), one step of it (state) or a change in its life (event). Every frame carries the contract version v, the run it belongs to and its position in the run. A consumer ignores members it does not know: a new member does not change v, and a change that removes or reinterprets a member does. A value that the simulation does not hold, such as the position of a train that has not entered, is null and is never a sentinel number. The frames are built by io/LiveFrame.h.

version.description: Version of the contract. Any other number is a different contract.

runId.description: Identifies one run. All frames of a run carry the same value.

seq.description: Position of the frame in its run, counted from 0 across all kinds of frame. It increases strictly.

serviceId.description: Id of the service that the train runs.

occurrence.description: Occurrence of the service, counted from 1. With service_id it names one train for the whole run.

operatingCode.description: Operating code of the train, as shown in the timetable.

hello.description: Opens a run: who it is, its time axis, its units and the trains it reports.

scene_name.description: Name of the scene that runs.

base_time_s.description: Time of day of step 0, in seconds from midnight.

horizon_steps.description: Number of steps of the run.

units.description: The unit of each kind of value in the frames of this run.

time.description: Unit of base_time_s, step_s, sim_time_s and clock_s.

trains.description: Every train of the run, also one that has not entered.

route_index.description: Position of the route of the train in the routes of the scene.

step.description: Number of the step, counted from 0.

sim_time_s.description: Seconds from the start of the run: step times step_s.

clock_s.description: Time of day: base_time_s plus sim_time_s. It is not reduced to one day.

trains.description: Every train of the run, also one that has not entered or has left.

in_network.description: True from the step in which the train is due until it has left the simulation.

direction.description: reversed when the route of the train is reversed.

route_pos_m.description: Position of the head on the route axis, in metres. null while the train has no position.

x_km.description: Coordinate of the head along the line, in km: the x of the block section that holds the head plus the distance into it, minus it on a reversed route. null while the train has no position or its head lies in no block section of its route.

speed_ms.description: Speed in m/s. null while the train has no position.

signals.description: The signal state of every section and direction. A sender may leave it out of a frame in which nothing changed since the last frame that has it.

code.description: Signalling code of the section: 270 green, 180 yellow, 75 red, 751 red_red (level 5 only) or 0 for an occupied or failed section; see docs/architecture/signalling-levels.md. null for a section without a signalling level.

level.description: Signalling level of the section, 0 to 5. null for a section without a level.

failed.description: A signal failure covers the section in this step.

reversed.description: The entry describes the section for trains on a reversed route.

event.description: A change in the life of the run.

stepsFinished.description: The step loop has ended and the positions are final. The result files may still be written.

step.description: Number of steps that have run.

runFinished.description: The run has ended and its result files are written.

step.description: Number of steps that have run.

status.description: cancelled when the run was stopped before its last step.
